{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check the distribution of sex and severity in treatment arm
print('Sex distribution in treatment arm:')
print(df_treatment['sex'].value_counts())

print('\nSeverity distribution in treatment arm:')
print(df_treatment['severity'].value_counts())

# Check if severity is confounded with sex in treatment arm
print('\nCross-tab: sex vs severity in treatment arm:')
print(pd.crosstab(df_treatment['sex'], df_treatment['severity']))"}
